items.headline: ChatGPT expands Work and Codex usage on Pro plans
items.summary: OpenAI increased Codex and work-related usage limits for ChatGPT Pro and Business Premium subscribers. The move reflects growing enterprise demand for AI coding and productivity tools.

items.headline: Anthropic reveals IPO prospectus amid AI market surge
items.summary: Anthropic disclosed its IPO prospectus as the AI company moves toward going public. The filing signals a major milestone for the AI industry and investor appetite for frontier labs.

items.headline: Trump administration moves to ban certain AI terminology
items.summary: President Trump introduced a ban on specific AI-related terms, drawing attention across the tech sector. The policy raises questions about government influence on AI discourse and regulation.

items.headline: Capgemini raises 2026 guidance on AI consulting demand
items.summary: French IT consulting firm Capgemini raised its 2026 guidance for the second time, citing a surge in AI-driven client work. The upgrade highlights how enterprise AI adoption is boosting IT services revenue.
